intended_object: The right residual α ▹ β of two almost-sign-preserving (ASP) integer permutations, from Pflueger's "An extended Demazure product" (Theorem 4.11). It is the unique ASP permutation whose slipface is s_α ▹ s_β, where (s ▹ t)(a,b) = max_ℓ [t(ℓ,b) − s^∨(ℓ,a)]. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the paper cited there.
